title: SimCity 3000 Unlimited

engine.name: Maxis GZ engine
engine.evidence: GZ-prefixed runtime DLLs (GZGraphicD, GZResourceD, GZServiceD, GZSOUNDD, GZTOOLSD, GZWIND, GZWWWD), SIM* simulation DLLs (SIMUI, SIMRCI, SIMSPR, SIMBABLD), Apps/SC3U.exe, Res/ data tree, Buildings/ and Cities/ folders.
engine.notes: The Steam copy is a GOG-packaged build (goggame-2086050016.dll, 2022 executable). That packaging is part of the installed state and is recorded, not normalised away.

userState.evidence: Cities directory ships inside the installation
shipped directory used by the retired exchange/chat browser

dependencies.evidence: literal URLs and the :6667 endpoint in Apps/SC3U.exe
dependencies.notes: Dead service from the dial-up era. The single-player simulation and local city saves do not use it.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan
staticAnalysis.limits: No runtime observation yet. The GOG wrapper's own behaviour on a machine with no network has not been measured.

notes: Nothing to implement unless a measured run shows the browser or wrapper blocking startup; preservation here is verification, not reconstruction.
